en.hubeali: Muhammad, from Ahmad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Dawood Al Raqy,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Al-Mudabbira (promised freedom upon the death of her master), when her master dies, that her waiting period is of four months and ten (days) from the day of the death of her master, if her master had copulated with her’. It was said to himasws, ‘Supposing the man who emancipates his owned slave girl before his death, by an hour, or by a day, then he dies’. So heasws said: ‘This one would observer the waiting period of three menstruations, or three Quroos (pure periods), from the day her master emancipated her’.
